items.title: Cassius Wilson Interview, 1962-04-05
items.q: Well we had, Celestan, he was an old brass band.

ctx.x: What about the olden time brass bands? Could you tell me a little bit more about that? Who's that? Some of the olden time brass bands.

Well we had, Celestan, he was an old brass band. Well Louis played too. Louis was a, he played parades and fumes in his time. We had Joe Oliver, he played for these dances, he played for fumes and parades. Well in Dallas time they used to play for the Carnival Parades. They had to play for Carnival Parades. No school band didn't play for Carnival Parades like they do today. That's why they had so many bands, because those colored bands used to play for all that. That was their job in my time. They played for all…
What neighborhood did you say you were brought up in?
